lines.t: (Verse 1)
Hey there Julie, I've been waiting for you,
right here, to put my arms around you,
and I, can't hold you close enough,
to my, heart which clings to you,
(chorus)
cuz I, am in love with you,
yes I, always do,
and I,will always be true,
cuz I, am in love with you,
(verse 2)
I remember when we first met,
never thought that I could have the chance,
yet all these years have went and gone on by,
a million more could never satisfy,
(chorus)
cuz I, am in love with you,
yes I, always do,
and I, will always be true,
cuz I, am in love with you,
(instrumental)
(outro)
I, will always love you,
just know I always do,
yes I, will always be true,
cuz I, am in love with you
(instrumental)
